name: EgoSuite-Open100K (EgoDemo)
tagline: Developer sample of EgoSuite-Open100K: 2,712 episodes / 79.5 h, 584 tasks, 299 environments in LeRobot v3, MCAP and MP4 (card says 50 h).

annotations.format: LeRobot v3 Parquet + MCAP (embedded Protobuf) for 4 annotated variants; MP4 + JSON for EgoRaw / EgoProRaw; per-variant manifests
annotations.coverageNote: Manifest flags over 2,712 episodes: head video 100 %, wrist video 59.5 %, hand pose 72.3 %, semantic annotations 72.3 %, body pose 32.6 %.

narrations.note: Subtask text per time segment on the 1,960 annotated episodes

action_labels.note: Skill tags + start/end per segment; task name per episode (584 tasks)

hand_pose.note: 21 joints per hand, (21,3) pos + (21,4) quat float32, world frame

camera_pose.note: Head/headcam (and wrist) poses + pinhole calibration per camera

depth.note: Declared in session metadata, never published in sampled MCAPs

audio_transcript.note: ffprobe: no audio in raw MP4s; no audio topic in MCAP

samples.caption: Project-page sample: hospitality task (preparing a cold drink)
LW-VIZ dashboard view of an episode: video, 3D hand/body skeletons, subtask text
